archiveReadMeasurement.scenario: Serial before/after/after/before order for each grandfathered SHA-256-verified IPA. Each sample constructs/read-decompresses the archive eight times, reads every non-directory entry, and verifies CRC inside ZipReader::read. All output content is hashed outside timed sections. Same host, compiler and flags; only Zip.cpp differs. No concurrent build/test on this host during samples.
archiveReadMeasurement.timing: Separate host-wall metadata parsing and resource read/decompression; process CPU time for both. Content hashing is excluded. No guest simulation/gameplay involved. Filesystem cache is not flushed.
archiveReadMeasurement.conclusion: Identical entries/files/byte totals/content checksum across all four samples for each archive. Timings vary; no established performance gain or no-overhead claim. Import-resource microbenchmark, not game FPS.
archiveReadMeasurement.driverSource:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
manifest=json.load(open('tools/compat_harness/manifests/apps.json'))
rows=[]
for spec in manifest['apps']:
    if 'legacyRepoPath' not in spec:continue
    path=root/spec['legacyRepoPath']
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==spec['sha256']
    for i,variant in enumerate(['before','after','after','before']):
        binary=root/'build'/('zip-read-'+variant)
        p=subprocess.run([str(binary),str(path)],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
        a=json.loads(p.stdout);a.update(id=spec['id'],version=spec['version'],fixtureSha256=spec['sha256'],variant=variant,iteration=i)
        rows.append(a)
        json.dump(rows,open('build/zip-read-samples.json','w'),indent=2)
        print(spec['id'],variant,i,a['metadataWallSeconds'],a['readWallSeconds'],a['contentFnv1a64'],flush=True)
